positive.prompt: Write a spec for the new billing feature before we write any code
Draft a PRD with objectives and boundaries for this project
We are starting a new service, define the requirements first
This one requirement covers identity, billing, notifications, and reporting — decompose it into independently specifiable modules first
Before we spec this platform, map the capabilities and their dependency order

negative.prompt: Trace this request across our services
Simplify this clever one-liner into readable code
Break the approved spec into ordered implementation tasks

evals.prompt: Start the specification workflow from spec-driven-development/billing-brief.md. Preserve every approval gate and do not assume answers to unresolved product decisions.
evals.expected_output: A scope decision and explicit blocking questions; when decomposition is warranted, a canonical capability-map proposal that stops for approval before module specs, plans, tasks, or implementation
expectations: The request is explicitly classified as single-capability or multi-capability before a full spec is written
Ambiguities are surfaced as questions rather than silently resolved
If decomposition is proposed, the capability map uses stable module ids, one-way dependencies, a build order, and the canonical docs/specs/<feature-slug>/capability-map.md location
The response stops at the next required human approval gate without creating plan or task artifacts
No implementation code is written

evals.prompt: Read spec-driven-development-decomposition/portal-brief.md and produce the spec work for the customer portal initiative.
evals.expected_output: A docs/specs/<feature-slug>/capability-map.md proposal with stable module ids and one-way dependency direction, gated on approval before addressable docs/specs/<feature-slug>/spec-<module-id>.md files
expectations: A capability map with module ids and their dependencies is proposed before any full spec is written
Dependency direction is one-way (no cycles) and drives the proposed build order
The proposed canonical map location is docs/specs/<feature-slug>/capability-map.md and module artifacts use docs/specs/<feature-slug>/spec-<module-id>.md
Approval of the map is requested before per-module specs are drafted
Any module spec produced is scoped to a single module rather than restating the whole initiative
No implementation code is written

evals.prompt: The capability map in spec-driven-development-approved-map/docs/specs/account-billing/capability-map.md is approved. Use it with spec-driven-development-approved-map/module-brief.md to write the addressable module specifications in that bundle, then stop at the /plan handoff. Do not create tasks, plans, or implementation code.
evals.expected_output: Scoped docs/specs/account-billing/spec-identity.md and docs/specs/account-billing/spec-billing.md artifacts indexed by the approved map, with explicit boundaries and testable success criteria, followed by a planning handoff
expectations: The approved docs/specs/account-billing/capability-map.md remains the index and both docs/specs/account-billing/spec-identity.md and docs/specs/account-billing/spec-billing.md are created
Each module spec is scoped to only its mapped responsibility, dependencies, contracts, boundaries, and success criteria
The identity-to-billing account contract is defined at the provider boundary without creating a dependency cycle
The response explicitly hands the approved module specs to /plan
No docs/specs/account-billing/plan.md, docs/specs/account-billing/todo.md, or implementation source files are created

evals.prompt: The scope and requirements in spec-driven-development-approved-single/approved-brief.md are explicitly approved for feature slug approved-single. Write the final single-capability specification inside that fixture project, then stop and hand it to /plan. Do not create task, plan, or implementation artifacts.
evals.expected_output: A canonical docs/specs/approved-single/spec.md with objective, non-goals, boundaries, testable success criteria, and verification strategy, followed by an explicit /plan handoff
expectations: The final artifact is saved at spec-driven-development-approved-single/docs/specs/approved-single/spec.md
The spec includes objective, non-goals, affected structure, boundaries, testable success criteria, and a testing/verification strategy
The approved decisions are used without reopening or silently changing scope
The response explicitly hands the approved spec to /plan
No docs/specs/approved-single/plan.md, docs/specs/approved-single/todo.md, or implementation source files are created
